highlights.title: SOC Dashboard — Network Intrusion Monitor
highlights.summary: Local Security Operations Center dashboard built on the real CIC-IDS2017 network intrusion dataset — Postgres holds 2.83M labeled flows, Grafana renders 17 dashboard-as-code panels with click-through filtering, and a Python ETL pipeline fixes real data-quality defects in the raw dataset before idempotent bulk loading. One documented limitation: the Behavioral Signature Map's scatter plot can't color points by attack type, since Grafana's native XY Chart panel only supports numeric color fields — hover a point to identify it via tooltip instead.
metrics: 2,830,743 labeled network flows loaded, 557,646 attack flows across 14 attack types
17 Grafana panels — 3 KPI cards, attack-type/family breakdowns, a behavioral scatter plot, and raw flow record drill-down, all provisioned as dashboard-as-code

4 click-through filter dimensions (day, attack type, port, class) — the class filter is deliberately excluded from panels whose own query logic already bakes in a class, avoiding a guaranteed-empty result
ETL fixes 5 real data-quality defects: mangled headers, a duplicate column, Infinity/negative sensor artifacts, mislabeled attack categories, and a µs-to-seconds unit mismatch

media.altText: Grafana SOC Analytics dashboard showing 2.83M total flows, 558K attack flows, 14 distinct attack types, a daily attack timeline, and attack type / attack family breakdown donut charts over the CIC-IDS2017 dataset

highlights.title: Cybersecurity Python Toolkit
highlights.summary: Three self-directed Python security tools built to practice hands-on SOC fundamentals, stdlib-only (hashlib, json, os, re, collections). File Integrity Checker: recursively SHA-256-fingerprints a target folder, saves a JSON baseline, and re-hashes on demand to report each file OK / CHANGED / MISSING — classic FIM logic. Password Strength Checker: scores an input 0-5 against length, uppercase, lowercase, digit, and symbol checks and prints a pass/fail breakdown with a verdict from 'Very Weak' to 'Excellent'. SSH Brute-Force Log Parser: regex-scans an auth log for 'Failed password' lines, extracts and tallies source IPs, and flags any IP over a configurable attempt threshold as a likely brute-force source.
metrics: 3 standalone tools, zero third-party dependencies
FIM: SHA-256 fingerprinting in 8192-byte chunks, baseline + verify workflow
Brute-force parser: flagged 2 of 4 source IPs as attackers on a 41-line sample auth log (192.168.1.10 at 23 attempts, 10.0.0.5 at 13, threshold 10)

media.altText: File Integrity Checker terminal output after a tamper test — detects a modified config file (CHANGED) and a deleted key file (MISSING) against a saved SHA-256 baseline

highlights.title: Mechanics & Heat Loss in ICE vs. EV Engines
highlights.summary: Cross-disciplinary Physics 2A final project analyzing why internal combustion engines lose roughly 80% of fuel energy to heat loss, using a 2021 Dodge Charger R/T 5.7L HEMI V8 as a real-world reference, then comparing that inefficiency against EVs using Phase Change Materials for thermal management. Delivered as a narrated video plus an interactive digital poster website with an embedded 3D engine explorer.
metrics: 9-part narrated video presentation
Interactive 3D ICE vs. EV engine explorer with quiz mode
Live companion site published for the class
